author: bardic-inspiration
name: Skyridge Lion
summary: A gray-maned mountain lion that leaps between cliffs and roars hard enough to knock climbers from the rock.
description: Skyridge lions keep territories that run from one peak to the next, and they cross the gaps between in a single bound. Their roar carries for leagues in still air, and in the passes it is reason enough to camp a day early.

traits.name: Cliff Leaper
traits.text: The lion's jump distance is tripled, and it takes no damage from falling 40 feet or less.

traits.name: Pounce
traits.text: If the lion moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a Claw attack on the same turn, the target must succeed on a {dc:str} Strength saving throw or have the {ref:condition/prone} condition. If the target has the Prone condition, the lion can make one Bite attack against it as a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The lion makes one Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Peak Roar
actions.onFailure: , and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the lion and has the {ref:condition/frightened} condition until the end of its next turn.
